title: 13-Day Greek Islands & Jordan Desert Journey
metaTitle: Santorini to Wadi Rum | 13-Day Greece Jordan Tour
metaDescription: Explore Athens, Mykonos and Santorini before Amman, Petra, Wadi Rum and the Dead Sea on a 13-day journey from the Aegean islands to Jordan's desert.
breadcrumb: Explore Our Travel Destinations & Multi-Country Tours
summary:
The 13-Day Greece & Jordan Tour combines Greece’s classical and island destinations with Jordan’s archaeological and desert landscapes. Begin in Athens before traveling by ferry to Mykonos and Santorini, with dedicated stays on both islands. After the Greek portion, continue to Amman and travel south to Petra, Wadi Rum and the Dead Sea. The route shifts from Aegean island travel to Jordan’s inland heritage and desert scenery, creating two distinct stages within one itinerary.
The escorted program operates from April to October and includes selected 4-star hotels, breakfast, professional local guides, entrance fees, airport transfers, Greek ferry tickets and land transportation in Jordan.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Athens
itinerary.text:
Arrival at Athens International Airport. Meet and transfer to your hotel in Athens.
Check-in after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Half day Athens City Tour
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Start a city tour of Athens, including visits to the Acropolis of Athens, the Acropolis Museum, and the famous Parthenon. Continue to see the Hellenic Parliament, the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier, and the National Library. Visit the Presidential Mansion to watch the Evzones Guards, then continue to the Panathenaic Stadium, the Temple of Olympian Zeus, and Hadrian's Arch. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Athens to Mykonos by Ferry
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel and check out. Transfer to Port of Piraeus and depart by Seajets ferry to Mykonos.
Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Mykonos.

itinerary.title: Free day in Mykonos
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Full day at leisure in Mykonos. Explore the charming streets of Mykonos Town and relax at the nearby beaches. Enjoy optional shopping, dining, or island activities, and experience the famous nightlife of the island. Overnight in Mykonos.

itinerary.title: Mykonos to Santorini by Ferry
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel and check out. Transfer to the port of Mykonos and depart by ferry to Santorini.
Upon arrival, meet and transfer to your hotel. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Santorini.

itinerary.title: Free day in Santorini
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Full day at leisure in Santorini. Relax on the island’s famous beaches such as Red Beach, Black Beach, or Perissa. Explore the capital town of Fira or join optional boat and bus excursions to the volcano and nearby islands. Overnight in Santorini.

itinerary.title: Santorini to Athens by Ferry
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel and check out. Free time at leisure until your transfer to the port.
Depart by Seajet ferry to Athens. Arrival in Athens and transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Athens to Amman by Flight
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel and check out. Transfer to Athens Airport for your flight to Amman.
Arrival at Amman. Meet our representative and transfer to your hotel. Check in at the hotel.
The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Amman.

itinerary.title: Visit Amman, Jerash and Aljoun
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Start a panoramic city tour of Amman. Visit the historic Amman Citadel, the impressive Roman Theatre, and the Folklore Museum. Continue to Ajloun Castle to explore the famous Islamic fortress overlooking the Jordan Valley. Proceed to Jerash for a guided tour of the well-preserved Greco-Roman city, famous for its colonnaded streets, temples, and arches. Return to Amman. Overnight in Amman.

itinerary.title: Visit Madaba, Mt Nebo and Kerak
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel and check out. Drive to Madaba and visit St. George’s Church, home to the famous mosaic map of the Holy Land. Continue to Mount Nebo, the memorial site of Prophet Moses, offering panoramic views over the Jordan Valley and the Dead Sea. Drive through the scenic Wadi Mujib mountains to Karak and visit the famous Kerak Castle, a historic Crusader fortress. Continue to Petra. Overnight in Petra.

itinerary.title: Visit Petra and Wadi Rum
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel and check out. Visit Petra, the famous rose-red city of the Nabataean civilization. Enjoy an optional horse ride or walk through the narrow Siq canyon to reach the stunning Al-Khazneh (Treasury). Continue to the Street of Facades, Royal Tombs, and Pharaoh’s Castle. Later, drive to Wadi Rum, also known as the Valley of the Moon, and enjoy an exciting 4x4 jeep safari across the desert landscape. Arrive at a Bedouin-style camp. Dinner and overnight in Wadi Rum.

itinerary.title: Visit Dead Sea, return Amman
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Drive to the Dead Sea, the lowest point on Earth. Enjoy free time to relax and float in the mineral-rich waters before continuing your drive back to Amman. Overnight in Amman.

itinerary.title: : Transfer to Amman Airport
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel and check out.
Transfer to Queen Alia International Airport for your return flight home.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the Explore Greece & Jordan in 13 Days tour?
faqs.a: The Explore Greece & Jordan in 13 Days tour covers Athens, Mykonos, and Santorini in Greece, along with Amman, Petra, Wadi Rum, and the Dead Sea in Jordan. This itinerary combines the beauty of the Greek Islands with Jordan's spectacular historical sites and desert landscapes, offering a perfect blend of culture, history, relaxation, and adventure. The tour runs for 12 nights and 13 days.

faqs.q: How much does the Explore Greece & Jordan in 13 Days tour cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €2,995 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, guided sightseeing tours, selected meals, airport and hotel transfers, domestic transportation, and one domestic flight. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates and hotel category.

faqs.q: Are flights included in the package?
faqs.a: Yes, one domestic flight is included within the itinerary. Additional transportation between destinations is provided according to the tour program. International flights are not included unless specifically stated.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide
faqs.a: The package includes accommodation in carefully selected hotels throughout Greece and Jordan. Daily breakfast is included, and additional meals may be provided according to the itinerary. Hotels are selected for their comfort, service quality, and convenient locations.

Yes, professional English-speaking guides accompany the scheduled sightseeing tours in both Greece and Jordan. Your guides will provide expert insights into the history, culture, archaeology, and traditions of each destination.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Greece and Jordan?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors. It combines the most famous highlights of both countries, providing an excellent introduction to the Mediterranean charm of Greece and the ancient wonders of Jordan.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through archaeological sites, historic districts, island towns, and desert landscapes. Petra requires extensive walking, while most other sightseeing activities are suitable for visitors with average fitness levels.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of the tour?
faqs.a: Highlights include the Acropolis and Parthenon in Athens, the charming streets and beaches of Mykonos, the breathtaking caldera views of Santorini, the vibrant capital city of Amman, the magnificent rose-red city of Petra, the dramatic desert scenery of Wadi Rum, and the unique floating experience at the Dead Sea.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the Explore Greece & Jordan in 13 Days tour?
faqs.a: Free cancellation is available up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 30 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms, airline conditions, and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Can the Explore Greece & Jordan in 13 Days tour be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour can be customized according to your preferences. You can add extra nights, upgrade hotel categories, include additional Greek islands, add destinations such as Jerash or Aqaba, or modify the itinerary to suit your travel interests. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
